title: Workspace settings
description: Send as Settings with Expected equal to the current workspace revision. A continuous run snapshots these values at startup.

max_rounds.description: Maximum continuous rounds. The CLI uses 5 until the first settings revision.

max_tokens.description: Provider token budget, checked between continuous rounds.

max_minutes.description: Wall-clock budget in minutes. The CLI uses 10 until the first settings revision.

observe.description: Skip applying approved changes during observation.

replay_gate.description: Hold learned rules for replay or review.

worker_count.description: Concurrent workers claiming units during each round.

max_failures.description: Stop before another round after reaching this many worker failures.

stagnant_rounds.description: Stop after this many successive comparisons find the graph unchanged.

judge_evaluations.description: Number of calls to the configured judge per proposal when a model is connected.

judge_approvals.description: Minimum approving evaluations. Must be at most judge_evaluations.
